title: How do you avoid overcomplicating an editorial illustration? Ana Miminoshvili has mastered the art

paragraphs.text: This illustrator cuts straight to the core of the story through low fantasy and reimagined realities.
paragraphs.translation: 這位插畫家透過低度奇幻與重新構想的現實，直接切入故事的核心。

paragraphs.text: For editorial illustrations, the brief is the article. The first step for Georgian illustrator Ana Miminoshvili is research, to gather as much information as possible and narrow it down to basically one sentence. That sentence becomes her memorable images for The New York Times, Los Angeles Times, Spotify, GQ and Die Zeit, constructed inside of Photoshop with “a sprinkle of Illustrator”, she tells It’s Nice That. “But the most important part, especially in the editorial work, is sketching. I always sketch with analog tools, I have different sketchbooks for different types of work,” she continues. “With editorials I start with just putting down the keywords, it might not seem like a big deal, but it’s super helpful to my process.” Once Ana has a list of keywords, it’s then onto drawing, outlining in black fine liners and reworking them in Photoshop. Illustrating book reviews are her favourite – she can take an entire literary world and condense it in a way that book cover designers do: tell a story in a way that only images can.
paragraphs.translation: 對於社論插畫來說，簡報內容就是文章本身。格魯吉亞插畫家 Ana Miminoshvili 的第一步是研究，盡可能收集資訊，並將其縮減到基本上只有一句話。這句話隨後成為她為《紐約時報》、《洛杉磯時報》、Spotify、《GQ》和《時代週報》所創作的令人難忘的圖像，這些圖像是在 Photoshop 中構建的，並「加入一點點 Illustrator 的點綴」，她告訴 It’s Nice That。她接著說：「但最重要的一部分，特別是在社論工作中，是草圖。我總是使用類比工具畫草圖，我有針對不同類型工作的各種速寫本。」「在處理社論時，我會先寫下關鍵字，這看起來可能沒什麼大不了，但對我的創作過程非常有幫助。」一旦 Ana 有了關鍵字列表，接著就是繪畫，用黑色針筆畫出輪廓，並在 Photoshop 中重新處理。為書評做插畫是她的最愛——她可以汲取整個文學世界，並以書封設計師的方式將其濃縮：用只有圖像才能做到的方式講述故事。

paragraphs.text: Ana’s work sumptuously blends many elements together. From grainy gradients to digital glosses, it looks like the perfect mix between analogue and digital tools coming together to make something that sits right in between – futuristic in its colours and classical in its approach, much like how line artists would send their work to colourists, except Ana takes on all the major shifts. Her work, which covers topics such as climate change, queer identities and death, touches upon deep feelings and brings them to the surface. In one illustration, a woman looks out of an airplane window which is hourglass-shaped – transience and the passing of time come together to communicate an emotional uncanny valley we often find difficult to express. In another, a tombstone is visited by a pink origami bird – Ana keeps the fantasy low, the colours realistic, but the textures clash in such a considered fashion. “My goal is to always be straightforward and not overcomplicate things,” says Ana. “According to my mom, I’ve been drawing since before I even started talking.”
paragraphs.translation: Ana 的作品華麗地揉合了許多元素。從顆粒感的漸層到數位光澤，它看起來像是類比與數位工具的完美結合，並產出介於兩者之間的作品——色彩上具有未來感，手法上則是古典的，就像線稿藝術家會將作品交給上色師一樣，只不過 Ana 包辦了所有主要的轉換過程。她的作品涵蓋了氣候變遷、酷兒身份和死亡等話題，觸及深層情感並將其展現出來。在一幅插畫中，一位女性從飛機窗口往外看，窗口是沙漏形狀的——轉瞬即逝與時間流逝匯聚在一起，傳達出一種我們通常難以表達的情感恐怖谷。在另一幅作品中，一隻粉紅色摺紙鳥探訪一塊墓碑——Ana 保持低度的奇幻感，色彩寫實，但材質以如此周全的方式產生碰撞。Ana 說：「我的目標始終是直接明瞭，不要把事情複雜化。據我媽說，我甚至在開始說話之前就一直在畫畫了。」

paragraphs.text: Paul M (He/Him) is a Junior Writer at It’s Nice That since May 2025. He studied (BA) Fine Art and has a strong interest in digital kitsch, multimedia painting, collage, nostalgia, analogue technology and all matters of strange stuff. pcm@itsnicethat.com
paragraphs.translation: Paul M (He/Him) 自 2025 年 5 月起擔任 It’s Nice That 的初級作家。他修讀純藝術學士學位，對數位庸俗、多媒體繪畫、拼貼、懷舊、類比科技以及各種奇特事物有著濃厚的興趣。pcm@itsnicethat.com

quiz.sentence: The chef added ____ salt to the soup to enhance the flavor.
quiz.sentence_zh: 廚師在湯裡加入了一點點鹽以提升風味。

quiz.sentence: He spent years practicing until he finally ____ the difficult piano piece.
quiz.sentence_zh: 他花了多年時間練習，直到最後精通了這首艱難的鋼琴曲。

quiz.sentence: The hotel was ____ decorated with gold leaves and velvet curtains.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這家飯店裝潢得非常華麗，到處是金箔和天鵝絨窗簾。

quiz.sentence: We need to ____ the list of candidates to the final three.
quiz.sentence_zh: 我們需要將候選人名單縮減到最後三名。

quiz.sentence: The architect designed a ____ building that looked like a spaceship.
quiz.sentence_zh: 建築師設計了一棟看起來像太空船、極具未來感的建築。

quiz.sentence: She appreciates the ____ beauty of cherry blossoms every spring.
quiz.sentence_zh: 她每年春天都欣賞櫻花那轉瞬即逝的美麗。

quiz.sentence: The instructions were so ____ that everyone could understand them immediately.
quiz.sentence_zh: 說明非常簡單明瞭，每個人都能立即理解。

quiz.sentence: Losing the game wasn't a ____ because it was just for fun.
quiz.sentence_zh: 輸掉比賽沒什麼大不了，因為那只是為了好玩。

quiz.sentence: The old photograph was ____, but it captured a very special moment.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這張舊照片雖然有顆粒感，但它捕捉了一個非常特別的時刻。

quiz.sentence: The author had to ____ the 500-page manuscript into a short summary.
quiz.sentence_zh: 作者必須將那份 500 頁的手稿濃縮成一份簡短的摘要。
